Attached: 1 image

Gelly is a new desktop music player built in Rust and GTK4/libadwaita, designed for streaming services like Jellyfin and Navidrome.

It supports synchronized line lyrics, ReplayGain, gapless playback, smart playlists, and MPRIS media controllers.

Note that it streams directly from your configured server without local file playback.

Available via Flathub.

https://en.hacks.gr/gelly-ena-neo-programma-gia-na-akoyte-ti-moysiki-sas-syllogi-ston-ypologisti/
